title: FIFA 08
shortDescription: FIFA 08 helps define a Wii sports path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Frames a sports catalog entry for source-aware Wii exploration.
Keeps the external item link distinct from the deterministic catalog method.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Logged for the Wii sports discovery path using the preserved Wikidata entity record; this remains a catalog record, never an aggregate score.
